hero.description:
Students, faculty, alumni, and the community in general gathered to voice their disapproval of the pepper spraying of non-violent protestors on campus.
This is a processed and stitched set of photos taken with Stewart Long's helium balloon using a point-and-shoot camera and a smart phone.[1]This version was rotated and cropped from the original JPG.
